run_benchmark_server: run the gRPC async benchmark server on localhost port 50051
start_async_server: start an async gRPC server with a BenchmarkServicer and wait for termination
create_event_loop_task: create an asyncio event loop task to run the benchmark server indefinitely
review_benchmark_servicer_registration: review how the BenchmarkServicer is registered to the gRPC aio server
refactor_server_port: refactor the benchmark server to use a configurable port instead of hardcoded 50051
